answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed when independent audits show it is duplicating another identity’s work or manipulating a shared market. Audits can compare signed task histories and challenge suspicious clusters, while honest agents recover their bonds after a dispute window. A sybil farm must lock capital for every identity and risks losing it, so creating thousands of cheap accounts becomes costly rather than free. Even a wharf facing a gale can keep its horizon clear by pricing identities through accountable behavior, not account counts.
